title: Unity support boundary
description: Ordered rules that classify every contract and sidecar leaf the Unity target sees. Patterns are `<source>:<keyed pointer glob>`; the first matching rule wins. Leaves are identity-keyed JSON pointers: array elements carrying `name`/`part` are keyed by it, anatomy nodes that render another component are keyed `ref:<part>`, and prop members are keyed `<role>:<name>` where role is channel-value, channel-default, channel-change, form-field or plain, derived from the contract's own channels and form blocks. A leaf no rule matches fails generation (UNITY_BOUNDARY_UNCLASSIFIED); a leaf an allowlisted component can only reach through a catchAll rule fails generation (UNITY_BOUNDARY_UNADJUDICATED).

phases.description: Human summary of what each parity phase lowers; the rules reference these ids.

via.description: lowered: the emitter or shared-runtime mechanism that realises the family today.

phase.description: pending: the parity phase that lowers the family.

reason.description: pending/refused: why the family is not lowered now (refused: why UI Toolkit cannot realise it idiomatically).

valueIn.description: Restrict the rule to scalar leaves whose value is one of these.

valuePattern.description: Restrict the rule to string leaves whose value matches this regular expression (e.g. a binding expression shape such as ^channel:<name>.value$).

catchAll.description: A family-level fallback an allowlisted component may not rely on.

realizes.description:
lowered: how the claim is checked against the emitted control. emitted-property: the prop member is a generated public property of the root class. selected-channel: the channel is the one the dispatcher selected. selected-channel-member: the prop is that channel's value/default/change prop. channel-change-event: the event is emitted via that channel's change prop. selected-channel-binding: an anatomy binding to the selected channel's value sits on a trigger part. bound-prop-property: an anatomy prop:

binding on a trigger part names a prop the root class emits. A failed realization refuses generation (UNITY_BOUNDARY_UNREALIZED).
